sentences.text:
----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Ramesh Chandra Purohit.
For Respondent(s) : Mr. Mahipal Bishnoi, P.P., with  Mr. Chetan Prakash Marwan.
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 19/05/2023

This application for bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner who has been arrested in connection with F.I.R. No.326/2021, registered at Police Station Arnod, District Pratapgarh, for offences under Sections 363, 366A, 376(2)(N), 376(3), 344, 504, 506 of the IPC and Sections 3/4(2), 5(L)/6 of the POCSO Act, 2012.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted during pendency of the present bail application, the petitioner has already been acquitted of the charges levelled against him.
Hence, the present bail application has become infructuous.
In view of the above, nothing remains to be adjudicated upon in the present bail application.
[2023/RJJD/016213] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-6898/2022] Accordingly, the present Criminal Misc. Bail Application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is dismissed as having been rendered infructuous.
